headline: Two NHL players placed on waivers for Nov. 8
take:
Daily Faceoff reported Arvid Soderblom on waivers for Nov. 8, looking headed back to the AHL. The numbers made this hard to avoid. In five games for Chicago he has an .842 save percentage and is 5.64 goals below expected (the goals an average goalie would allow on the same shots), already worse than the -4.68 he posted across 26 games last season. Five games is a small sample, but it is pointing the same way as a whole season did, and that's what costs a goalie a job.

The same outlet has the Wild putting Cameron Crotty and Tyler Pitlick on the wire Monday. Pitlick has no points in 12 games on 1.62 expected goals, so a little unlucky, but on a Minnesota team that is 12-3-4 and controlling 56% of the chances, a fourth-line spot is a short leash.
